patthana24.5:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.5:3.1: na hetuṃ no ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.5:5.1: na hetuṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.5:7.1: na hetuṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.5:9.1: na hetuṃ nonīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.5:11.1: na hetuṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
